question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT cu.cust_city, t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
  GROUP BY cu.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT q2019.cust_city
  FROM city_sales q2019
  JOIN city_sales q2020 ON q2019.cust_city = q2020.cust_city
  WHERE q2019.calendar_year = 2019 AND q2020.calendar_year = 2020
    AND q2019.total_sales > 0
    AND 1.0 * (q2020.total_sales - q2019.total_sales) / q2019.total_sales >= 0.20
),
city_product_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND cu.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_year
),
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name, SUM(product_sales) as total_product_sales
  FROM city_product_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name, total_product_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) as tile
  FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20_percent AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name
  FROM ranked_products
  WHERE tile = 1
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT cps.prod_id, cps.prod_name, cps.calendar_year, cps.product_sales
  FROM city_product_sales cps
  WHERE cps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_20_percent)
),
total_sales_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT t.calendar_year, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    AND cu.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    pqs.prod_name,
    pqs.calendar_year,
    pqs.product_sales,
    tsql.total_sales,
    1.0 * pqs.product_sales / tsql.total_sales as share
  FROM product_quarter_sales pqs
  JOIN total_sales_by_quarter tsql ON pqs.calendar_year = tsql.calendar_year
),
pivot_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share ELSE NULL END) as share_2020
  FROM product_shares
  GROUP BY prod_name
)
SELECT 
  prod_name,
  share_2019,
  share_2020,
  share_2020 - share_2019 as share_change
FROM pivot_shares
ORDER BY share_change DESC
